503: /-- An induction principle for closure membership. If `p` holds for `0`, `1`, and all elements
504: of `s`, and is preserved under addition, negation, and multiplication, then `p` holds for all
505: elements of the closure of `s`. -/
506: @[elab_as_elim]
507: theorem closure_induction {s : Set R} {p : (x : R) → x ∈ closure s → Prop}
508:     (mem : ∀ (x) (hx : x ∈ s), p x (subset_closure hx))
509:     (zero : p 0 (zero_mem _)) (one : p 1 (one_mem _))
510:     (add : ∀ x y hx hy, p x hx → p y hy → p (x + y) (add_mem hx hy))
511:     (neg : ∀ x hx, p x hx → p (-x) (neg_mem hx))
512:     (mul : ∀ x y hx hy, p x hx → p y hy → p (x * y) (mul_mem hx hy))
513:     {x} (hx : x ∈ closure s) : p x hx :=
514:   let K : Subring R :=
515:     { carrier := { x | ∃ hx, p x hx }

39: /-- An `sl₂` triple within a Lie ring `L` is a triple of elements `h`, `e`, `f` obeying relations
40: which ensure that the Lie subalgebra they generate is equivalent to `sl₂`. -/
41: structure IsSl2Triple (h e f : L) : Prop where
42:   h_ne_zero : h ≠ 0
43:   lie_e_f : ⁅e, f⁆ = h
44:   lie_h_e_nsmul : ⁅h, e⁆ = 2 • e
45:   lie_h_f_nsmul : ⁅h, f⁆ = -(2 • f)

52: lemma symm (ht : IsSl2Triple h e f) : IsSl2Triple (-h) f e where
53:   h_ne_zero := by simpa using ht.h_ne_zero
54:   lie_e_f := by rw [← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, lie_skew, ht.lie_e_f]

classical
  have hp : Prime (p : ℤ) := Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by simpa using h_H001)
  have hm : ∀ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ a → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ a*b :=
    fun a b ha hb hab => (hp.dvd_mul.mp hab).elim ha hb
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    induction hq using Subring.closure_induction with
    | mem q hq =>
      obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hq
      exact ⟨1, d, hd, by simp⟩
    | zero => exact ⟨0, 1, hp.not_dvd_one, by simp⟩
    | one => exact ⟨1, 1, hp.not_dvd_one, by simp⟩
    | add q s hq hs iq is =>
      obtain ⟨a,d,hd,rfl⟩ := iq
      obtain ⟨b,e,he,rfl⟩ := is
      refine ⟨a*e+b*d, d*e, hm d e hd he, ?_⟩
      have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (fun h => hd (h ▸ dvd_zero _))
      have he0 : (e : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (fun h => he (h ▸ dvd_zero _))
      push_cast
      field_simp
      <;> ring
    | neg q hq iq =>
      obtain ⟨a,d,hd,rfl⟩ := iq
      exact ⟨-a,d,hd,by simp⟩
    | mul q s hq hs iq is =>
      obtain ⟨a,d,hd,rfl⟩ := iq
      obtain ⟨b,e,he,rfl⟩ := is
      exact ⟨a*b,d*e,hm d e hd he,by push_cast; ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,d,hd,rfl⟩
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (Reduction.loc p).mul_mem ((Reduction.loc p).intCast_mem a)
      (Subring.subset_closure ⟨d,hd,rfl⟩)

 Nonempty (Basis (Reduction.Ind l) (Reduction.loc p) (Reduction.MR p M)) ∧
 Module.finrank (Reduction.loc p) (Reduction.MR p M) = l.toNat + 1 ∧
 Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (Reduction.iota p M)) = ⊤
arguments.proof:
classical
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab⟩ := @yui_aux_0007 p l K fieldK V addV modV act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H003 h_H005 h_H007 h_T002
  let ar : Basis (Reduction.Ind l) (Reduction.loc p) (Reduction.MR p M) := a.baseChange (Reduction.loc p)
  have har : ∀ i, Reduction.iota p M (ar i) = b i := by
    intro i
    simpa [ar, Reduction.iota] using hab i
  have hli : LinearIndependent (Reduction.loc p) b :=
    @yui_aux_0008 p l K fieldK V addV modV act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H003 h_H005 h_H007 h_T002 b
  have hli' : LinearIndependent (Reduction.loc p) ((Reduction.iota p M) ∘ ar) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, har] using hli
  refine ⟨LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent ar.span_eq hli', ⟨ar⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [Reduction.Ind] using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis ar
  · apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem b).mpr
    intro i
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨ar i, har i⟩

arguments.proof:
intro f hf z hz
  obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := hz
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (Reduction.iota p M).range.zero_mem
  | tmul s m =>
    refine ⟨s ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (⟨f m, hf m⟩ : M), ?_⟩
    change algebraMap (Reduction.loc p) ℂ s • f (m : V) =
      f (algebraMap (Reduction.loc p) ℂ s • (m : V))
    exact (f.map_smul _ _).symm
  | add u w hu hw =>
    simpa only [map_add] using (Reduction.iota p M).range.add_mem hu hw
